title: LATTICE: Turning Freeway Data Into Real-Time Intelligence
content: LATTICE is an operational research platform that converts live freeway detector streams into traffic state, prediction, emissions, cost, sensor health, and event-impact intelligence at one-minute resolution. Deployed on the Las Vegas metropolitan freeway network, LATTICE ingests measurements from approximately 1,000 Nevada Department of Transportation FAST detector locations every 60 seconds and processes them through four concurrent engines: a network health and sensor validation engine, an EMFAC-based emissions estimator covering 18 pollutant and energy metrics, a monetized impact engine grounded in the EPA Social Cost of Carbon, BenMAP per-ton health damage values, and USDOT travel-time valuation, and a corridor-specific graph-based spatio-temporal prediction service producing 15-, 30-, 45-, and 60-minute speed forecasts with continuous online MAE and RMSE tracking. All outputs are delivered to a six-view interactive dashboard viaWebSocket, persisted under tiered retention policies, and surfaced through automated daily and event-driven operational reports. By unifying live detector ingestion, environmental impact estimation, economic valuation, multi-horizon forecasting, and operational reporting within an extensible deployed system, LATTICE demonstrates a practical architecture for next-generation intelligent transportation systems in rapidly growing urban environments.
